fusions.name: Loosened Keystone
fusions.desc: Knocks a keystone loose, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stunning each for 1 second and leaving it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Anvil Rock
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. Cracks it against the anvil rock for 22 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Propped Boulder
fusions.desc: Props a boulder on a stick at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles takes 22 damage in a blast around it.

fusions.name: Pocketful of Pebbles
fusions.desc: Every hit you land adds a stack, up to 8. At 8 they all release at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (218% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
